python3 - <<'PY'
p='crates/elephc-magician/src/interpreter/tests/builtins_math_formatting.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = '/// Verifies eval `sscanf()` returns indexed string matches through callable paths.'
new = ('/// Verifies eval `sscanf()` returns php-typed matches through callable paths.\n'
       '///\n'
       "/// The `-2.5e3` case reads `-2500`, not the matched text: `%f` yields a FLOAT, so echoing\n"
       "/// it prints php's float rendering. This assertion used to read `-2.5e3`, pinning the\n"
       '/// string-slice answer the old scanf subset gave — `php -n` (8.5.6) answers `float(-2500)`.')
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2 = '    assert_eq!(values.output, "John:1.5:30:-25:-2.5e3:ok:");'
new2 = '    assert_eq!(values.output, "John:1.5:30:-25:-2500:ok:");'
assert s.count(old2)==1
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('patched sscanf eval test')
